summary: This release adds focused daily, task and configuration review Skills and makes original conversation evidence faster to find.
highlights: Use three task Skills for daily usage and improvement reviews, selected-task retrospectives, and configuration reviews. Each keeps the selected scope and connects recommendations to recorded evidence.

Find and locate historical conversation messages with less repeated decoding and lazy history loading. Interface-injected context is excluded from normal message results while explicitly requested evidence remains accessible.

Read selected original text before recommending changes. Task reviews distinguish required validation and expected failures from accidental repetition; configuration reviews retain the original suggestion for authorized follow-up checks.
Plugin installation verifies every packaged Skill and reports concrete installation or discovery failures with the appropriate recovery step, avoiding unnecessary full reinstalls.
knownLimitations: Codex is the only production data source in this release; support for other agents is planned.
Recent preparation covers the default 30-day window. Historical requests can require additional preparation. Missing, deferred, partial and unpriced results remain explicit.

Background indexing and cache limits do not impose a hard process-memory ceiling. Initial preparation, large source catch-up and detail requests can still use substantial memory and temporary disk space.
Measured warm complete CLI requests met a 100 ms P95 target on the local acceptance corpus. Cold requests and individual outliers can exceed 100 ms; this is not a per-request latency guarantee.

The 24-hour resident workload qualification and native user-session manager acceptance on Linux and Windows remain separate acceptance work. macOS crash recovery and pause/resume were tested locally; generated service definitions alone do not prove login-startup behavior.

Original-text access supports selected message mappings and text parts. Unknown mappings, non-text content and delta-stream assembly remain explicit gaps; there is no transcript panel in the Web dashboard.

Conversation reads verify selected source text blocks and reject changed, replaced, missing or unavailable sources. A successful snippet does not prove that the complete source file is unchanged. Changes require a valid fixed baseline and do not establish additional work or savings.
API costs are estimates. Unpriced or partial data stays explicit and is separate from subscription allowance.

Unsupported derived index and parser-cache formats require a rebuild. Existing data is not migrated or automatically deleted. Follow the documented format recovery and preserve user decisions; a different WOMBAT_DATA_HOME does not transfer them.
Timing describes recorded activity and can be partial or provisional. It does not establish why work was slow, code quality, token savings, or model performance.
A sharing summary removes direct identifiers but does not guarantee anonymity. Preview it before sharing.
Native Codex plugin discovery and Hook registration require a compatible local Codex. Windows Hook collection remains unverified.
